name: report_lost_stolen
description: Block a card and flag the account after it is lost or stolen.

client_id.description: Client identifier returned by find_client, or supplied by the orchestrator. Never invent one.

card_id.description: Card identifier returned by list_cards. Never invent one.

incident_type.description: Ask the advisor which it was. Do not assume.

last_known_use.description: Optional free text, e.g. 'Tuesday at a petrol station'.

flag_transactions.description: True only if the advisor says the client does not recognise recent transactions.
